name: find-customer
description: Finds Stripe customers by email address (an exact, case-sensitive match) or by part of their name. Each customer id feeds stripe__get-customer, stripe__list-invoices, stripe__list-payments, stripe__list-subscriptions and stripe__create-invoice. When hasMore is true, nextCursor passed back as cursor reads the next page.

query.description: An email address for an exact, case-sensitive match, or part of a customer name.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of an earlier answer to the same query, to read the customers after it.
